title: PILLAGER ARMY
description: This mod adds new creatures, a new interface, and even magic. It also improves raids, making them more complex.
body:
![Ender man ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8430af7f20fd171fd0b317a99322c0ebb977c29c_0.webp)![The mage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cc65eee133dc20c26b56c4e87bb51a84fee9e58_0.webp)Enhance 

Enhance your gameplay with this feature-rich mod. It adds a variety of unique creatures, an overhauled user interface, a brand-new magic system, and improves existing raids, making them more complex and thrilling.


Technical Details

Visuals: Fully compatible with shaders and Physics Mod.

Compatibility: Available now for NeoForge.

Upcoming: A Forge version is currently in development.

also working for fabric and maybe for bedrock edition


Performance Warning: Compatibility with Physics Mod
This mod includes numerous explosive projectiles and block-destruction mechanics that heavily strain CPU and GPU resources. We strongly advise against using this mod alongside Physics Mod or similar advanced physics mods to prevent significant FPS drops, game freezes, or client crashes.
By installing these mods together, you do so at your own risk. We are not responsible for any game instability or potential hardware stress, such as overheating or component wear, resulting from the excessive system load. If you experience performance issues, please disable advanced physical effects or reduce your entity and particle render distances.
